text:
I needed to get a PCR test in Krabi, and I came here because it was conveniently located and seemed to have good reviews. It didn't require a deep scan, and I was able to get the test done with peace of mind.
If you have any questions, please email me at the email address listed here for a quick response.

In my case, I had to leave on Monday night, so I emailed to ask if the clinic was open on Sunday. I received a promising response that even if I got the test on Saturday, it would still be available on Sunday. They also said that if I got the test before 10 AM on Monday, the results would be available by 5 PM. This made my trip much more comfortable. I initially went at 5:20 PM on Saturday, but it was already closed, so I was disappointed. I went on Monday morning, got the test done, and received the results by email around 3 PM. Thanks to them, my trip was smooth. The person who tested me was very friendly, and they even had a cat with them.
